verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS platform publishes its own source under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Glama's own code is public or openly licensed. The "open-source servers" in its catalog are third-party projects, and the OpenAPI license block covers attribution for data use, not source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
